checks.name: lesson_attempts_completion_bounds_check
checks.definition: CHECK (((completed_at IS NULL) OR ((k_first_wrong IS NOT NULL) AND (k_first_wrong >= 0) AND (k_first_wrong <= n_core) AND (response_count IS NOT NULL) AND (response_count = ((n_core)::bigint + (k_first_wrong)::bigint)) AND (contribution_units IS NOT NULL) AND (contribution_units >= (2 * ((n_core)::bigint - (k_first_wrong)::bigint))) AND (contribution_units <= ((2 * (n_core)::bigint) - (k_first_wrong)::bigint)) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM timezone_at_completion)) > 0))))

checks.name: lesson_attempts_completion_shape_check
checks.definition: CHECK ((((completed_at IS NULL) AND (k_first_wrong IS NULL) AND (contribution_units IS NULL) AND (response_count IS NULL) AND (completion_operation_key IS NULL) AND (qualifying_local_date IS NULL) AND (timezone_at_completion IS NULL)) OR ((completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (k_first_wrong IS NOT NULL) AND (contribution_units IS NOT NULL) AND (response_count IS NOT NULL) AND (completion_operation_key IS NOT NULL) AND (qualifying_local_date IS NOT NULL) AND (timezone_at_completion IS NOT NULL))))

checks.name: lesson_responses_contribution_rule_check
checks.definition: CHECK ((((response_ordinal = 1) AND (is_correct = true) AND (contribution_units = 2)) OR ((response_ordinal = 1) AND (is_correct = false) AND (contribution_units = 0)) OR ((response_ordinal = 2) AND (is_correct = true) AND (contribution_units = 1)) OR ((response_ordinal = 2) AND (is_correct = false) AND (contribution_units = 0))))

triggers.name: trg_lesson_completion_immutable
triggers.trigger_definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_lesson_completion_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON app.lesson_completions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_no_update()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app.guard_no_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Record is immutable and cannot be updated' USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
END;
$function$
